summary: Agroz Inc. reported results of an extraordinary general meeting held on May 22, 2026. Shareholders approved resolutions to amend authorized share capital, adopt amended articles, effect a reverse share split (2:1 to 20:1), and authorize related actions. The vote tallies are provided for each resolution. This is a routine corporate governance event—no acquisition, divestiture, tender, or other special situation is involved. The filing is a Form 6-K, the foreign private issuer equivalent of a Form 8-K for material events, but here it merely reports shareholder approvals of capital structure changes and a reverse split, which are not categorized as a special situation under event-driven analysis.
